title: めぶんりょうクイズ
concept: 数えない・測らない、ひと目の感覚で答える目分量クイズ。豆は数秒だけ見せて布をかぶせ、角度、コップの水の量、ランプの秒数、線の長さ、円の広さを見積もる。答え合わせで正解の針が数直線を走って自分のピンに近づくドキドキと、円すいのコップや広さの倍率で目がだまされる驚きが核。
howToPlay: 左右にドラッグして答えの数を合わせ、「これだ！」を押す。近いほど高得点で、10問の合計を競う。
libraryDecision: 使わない。豆を皿に散らす・数えながら光らせる・水位や角度の目盛りを描く演出は Canvas 2D で十分なめらかに作れ、物理や3Dを足しても『ひと目で見積もる』面白さは強まらないため。
soundDecision: BGMは入れず、見ることに集中できる静けさにした。ドラッグで値が変わるたびの小さなカチッ、答え合わせで数えるたびに上がっていく音程、判定ごとのジングルで、正解の針が自分の予想に近づく緊張を耳でも盛り上げる。

improvements.found: 豆が見えたまま14秒あるので、最初の問題はただ数えるだけになり「ひと目」の感覚クイズにならない／判定の文字が数え上げの数字や水の目盛りに重なって読めない／赤い豆が黒豆とほとんど見分けられず、円の広さの答え合わせも四角が並ぶだけで分かりにくい
improvements.changed: 豆の問題は2〜3秒だけ見せて布をかぶせる形にし、残り時間を皿のふちの輪で見せた。判定と得点は下の答えパネルに移し、数え上げの数字は皿の下へ。赤い豆を明るい赤にし、円の広さは小さい円を1つずつ大きい円の中へ並べる答え合わせにした。結果画面に「多めに見るタイプ／少なめに見るタイプ」の一言を足した
improvements.foundEn: Beans stayed visible for 14 s, so the first question became plain counting rather than an at-a-glance guess; grade text overlapped the counter and the volume scale; red beans were nearly indistinguishable from black ones, and the circle-area reveal was just a grid of squares
improvements.changedEn: Bean questions now show the plate for only 2–3 s (a ring shows the time) and then a cloth covers it. Grade and points moved into the answer panel and the counter below the plate. Red beans are now bright red; the area reveal stamps copies of the small circle into the big one. The result screen adds a line saying whether you tend to guess high or low

improvements.found: 答えのピンが毎回真ん中から始まるので、何もせずに押しても水の量などで高得点が出てしまう／毎回同じ10問の並びで、2回目に新しさがない／ゆっくりドラッグすると値がほとんど動かず、もどかしい
improvements.changed: ピンの初期位置を毎回ランダムにして、自分で合わせないと当たらないようにした。「長い線は短い棒の何本分？」の問題を足し、2・6・8問目は角度・線の長さ・円の広さ・ランプから毎回入れ替わるようにした。ゆっくりドラッグしたときの動きを速くした
improvements.foundEn: The answer pin always started in the middle, so pressing without moving it still scored well on things like water; every run had the same 10 questions in the same order; slow drags barely moved the value
improvements.changedEn: The pin now starts at a random spot each question, so you must set it yourself. Added a "how many sticks long is the line?" question, and slots 2, 6 and 8 now rotate between angle, line length, circle area and lamp time. Slow drags respond more

candidates.idea: 目分量クイズ。豆の数・角度・水の量・秒数などをひと目で見積もり、答え合わせで正解の針が自分の予想を越えていく。
candidates.ideaEn: An eyeballing quiz: estimate bean counts, angles, water volume and seconds at a glance; on reveal the answer needle races past (or stops at) your guess.

candidates.idea: 夜の軒先に風鈴を吊るし、風の通り道で鳴り方が変わる音の遊び場。目標も終わりもない。
candidates.ideaEn: A sound playground of wind chimes under night eaves; how they ring depends on the wind paths. No goal, no end.

candidates.idea: 流しそうめんを箸でつまむ。流れの速さと麺のすべりを読み、つまむ瞬間の指の開き加減で量が変わる。
candidates.ideaEn: Catch flowing somen noodles with chopsticks: read the stream speed and slipperiness; how wide you pinch decides how much you catch.

en.title: Eyeball It!
en.concept: A quiz answered by gut sense, never counting or measuring: beans flash for a few seconds before a cloth covers them, then angles, water in odd glasses, how long a lamp shone, line lengths and circle areas. The core is the reveal, when the answer needle races along the number line toward your pin, and the surprise when cone glasses and area ratios fool your eye.
en.howToPlay: Drag left/right to set your number, then press "That's it!". Closer guesses score more; 10 questions per game.
en.libraryDecision: None. Scattering beans, lighting them up as they are counted, and drawing volume and angle scales all run smoothly in Canvas 2D; physics or 3D would not make at-a-glance estimating more fun.
en.soundDecision: No BGM, so you can focus on looking. A tiny click as the value changes, rising pitch with each counted item during the reveal, and a jingle per grade make the needle approaching your guess tense to hear as well.

aiReview.worst: 問題の種類が6つしかなく、数回遊ぶと見慣れてしまう。ランプの秒数だけは見る問題ではなく、答え合わせも点灯時間ぶん待たされて間延びする
aiReview.comment: 角度147°をぴったり当てたときの、正解の針が自分のピンにぴたりと止まる瞬間は気持ちよかった。円すいのコップで高さ6割を60%と答えたら正解36%で、目盛りが下に詰まっていく答え合わせに素直に驚いた。豆は数秒で布がかかるので数えられず、本当に目分量になる。結果の「6%多めに見るタイプ」は少し次を試したくなる。一方で問題の型は早めに出尽くし、何度も戻るほどの深さはまだない。

similar.title: The Eyeballing Game
similar.note: 目だけで角度や中点を合わせて誤差を競う点が近い。こちらは数を答えるクイズ形式で、豆の数・水の量・時間なども扱い、正解の針が走る答え合わせを見せる
similar.note_en: Close in judging angles and midpoints by eye and scoring the error. This one is a quiz where you answer a number, covers bean counts, water volume and time too, and stages a reveal with a running answer needle

similar.title: Stars（数の見積もりゲーム）
similar.note: 画面の点の数を見積もるゲーム。こちらは豆を数秒だけ見せて布で隠し、数え上げながら正解へ近づく演出と、他の種類の問題を混ぜている
similar.note_en: A game of estimating how many things are on screen. Here the beans flash briefly before a cloth hides them, the reveal counts up toward the answer, and other question types are mixed in

aiReview.research: WebSearch で目分量・見積もりゲームを1回検索し、角度などを目で合わせる The Eyeballing Game と、数を見積もる Stars を見つけた

en.worst: Only six question types, so they feel familiar after a few runs. The lamp question is about timing rather than looking, and its reveal makes you wait out the whole duration
en.comment: Hitting a 147° angle exactly, with the answer needle stopping right on my pin, felt great. On the cone glass I said 60% from the height and the answer was 36%; watching the volume marks bunch up at the bottom was a genuine surprise. Beans get covered after a few seconds, so you truly have to eyeball them. The 'you guess 6% high' line made me want one more try. But the question types run out quickly; not yet deep enough to keep coming back.
en.research: One WebSearch for eyeballing/estimation games found The Eyeballing Game (matching angles by eye) and Stars (estimating counts)
